blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies. This reliance stems from the fundamental limitation of standard CLIP architectures, where [CLS] token attention and spatial patch pooling struggle to capture subtle, localized anomaly features. While prompt-learning approaches aim to bridge this gap, they typically require a large number of ground-truth segmentation masks from auxiliary datasets, which are often unavailable in specialized domains. In this work, we show an emerging property of multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models: remarkable zero-shot anomaly localization and detection right out of the box. We translate this property into a single-pass anomaly detection technique, RADIOlogy, that does not require dense, windowed execution and significantly outperforms other training-free baselines. Instead, the method relies on a simple contrastive scoring approach that compares the average similarity between vision features and a suite of normal and abnormal prompts. Furthermore, we leverage the agglomerative features of RADIO models to enhance pixel-level anomaly segmentation using a dense anomaly refinement pipeline. Finally, we show how the vision-language family of training-free zero-shot anomaly detection techniques can be applied successfully to the medical domain with minimal modifications. Code is available at https://github.com/jacomof/RADIOlogy.
blocks.zh: 目前零发异常探测方法往往依靠复杂的即时学习技术或计算昂贵的滑动窗口策略来实现细纹视觉对接以检测出小规模异常. 这种依赖源于标准CLIP架构的根本局限,其中[CLS]表示注意和空间补丁集合斗争,以捕捉微妙,局部的异常特征. 虽然即时学习办法旨在弥合这一差距,但它们通常需要从辅助数据集中取出大量地面-真实分解口罩,而这些口罩往往在专门领域得不到。 在这部作品中,我们展示了在视觉语言模型中集合多头注意力的新兴属性:显著的零发反常局部化和从盒子中检测出. 我们把这个属性转化为一个单行道异常检测技术,即RADIOlogy,它不需要密集而有窗口地执行,并且大大地超过了其他没有训练的基线. 相反,该方法依赖于一种简单的对比分法,比较视觉特征与一组正常和异常的提示之间的平均相似性. 此外,我们利用RADIO模型的凝聚性特性,利用密集的异常改进管来增强像素级异常分化. 最后,我们表明,无训练零发反常检测技术的视觉语系如何能在最小的修改下成功地应用于医疗领域。 代码见https://github.com/jacomof/radiology。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Visual Anomaly Detection (AD) aims to identify and localize irregular visual patterns in images, which are often associated with anomalies [ 3 ] .
Because anomalous occurrences are inherently rare and structurally unpredictable, traditional approaches model the distribution of normal appearances via unsupervised or self-supervised representations [ 37 , 10 , 11 , 15 , 27 ] .
Recent breakthroughs in multi-modal foundation models and zero-shot transfer have allowed for a relatively new family of techniques to emerge: Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) [ 20 , 53 ] , methods that identify out-of-distribution defects without access to reference normal samples from the target distribution. Within ZSAD, existing paradigms broadly bifurcate into cross-dataset trained methods [ 7 , 30 ] , which learn auxiliary defect priors from separate annotated datasets, and training-free methods, which rely strictly on the intrinsic representations of frozen foundation models [ 20 , 29 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
视觉异常检测(AD)旨在识别和定位图像中的不规则视觉模式,这些模式往往与异常现象[3]有关.
由于异常现象在本质上是罕见的和结构上的不可预测的,传统方法通过无监督或自我监督的表述来模拟正常外观的分布[37,10,11,15,27].
近期在多模式基础模型和零射线转移方面的突破使得技术领域出现了相对较新的一系: Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) [20,53],在无法从目标分布中获取参考正常样本的情况下识别分布外缺陷的方法. 在ZSAD内部,现有的范式大致分为交叉数据集训练方法[7,30],这些方法从单独的附加说明的数据集中学习辅助缺陷前科,而无训练方法则严格依赖冻结基模型的内在表现[20,29,19].

blocks.en:
Training-free approaches are particularly compelling for real-world deployments: they bypass the operational overhead and computational expense of auxiliary training [ 20 ] , adapt immediately to severe domain shifts [ 49 ] , and eliminate the requirement for curated defect annotations in specialized downstream domains [ 7 ] .
Until recently, training-free pipelines were anchored by WinCLIP [ 20 ] , which queries the weakly supervised vision-language model (VLM) CLIP [ 34 ] against predefined prompt ensembles.
However, a fundamental limitation of the standard CLIP architecture is its weak patch-level vision-language alignment [ 52 , 48 ] .
To circumvent the noisy localization of raw patch embeddings, WinCLIP relies on an expensive multi-scale sliding-window execution, extracting the [CLS] token over a large number of local crops per image.
While effective at bypassing CLIP’s poor dense features, this multi-pass windowing introduces inference latency and computational overhead.
Consequently, recent works leveraging CLIP have shifted toward prompt-tuning or fine-tuning vision-language backbones on auxiliary anomaly corpora [ 53 , 30 ] , largely abandoning training-free architectures.
blocks.zh:
无培训方法对于现实世界的部署尤其具有说服力:它们绕过辅助培训的业务间接费用和计算费用[20],立即适应严重领域转移[49],并取消对下游专门领域的缺陷说明的要求[7]。
直到最近,无培训的管道都由WinCLIP[20]锚定,该管道对弱监督的视觉语言模型(VLM)CLIP[34]对预定义的即时综艺节目进行询问.
然而,标准CLIP架构的一个根本限制是其薄弱的补丁级视觉语言配对[52,48].
为避免原始补丁嵌入器的噪音本地化,WinCLIP依赖于昂贵的多尺度滑动窗执行,将[CLS]符号提取到每个图像上大量的当地农作物上.
这种多通道的窗口化虽然能有效绕过CLIP的低密度特征,但引入了推论延迟和计算间接费用。
因此,最近利用CLIP的作品已经转向了在辅助异常阵型[53,30]上快速调整或微调视觉语言主干,基本上放弃了无培训建筑.

blocks.en:
In this work, we demonstrate that modern advances in vision-language architectures render complex windowing pipelines unnecessary, with the ultimate objective of reinvigorating language-aligned, training-free anomaly detection.
By investigating the Multi-Head Attention Pooling (MAP) mechanism adopted in the SigLIP family [ 51 , 45 ] and consolidated within modern agglomerative foundation models, such as C-RADIOv4 [ 36 ] , we uncover an emergent capability: MAP-pooled encoders produce inherently well-aligned dense vision-language anomaly features directly from a single forward pass.
Because MAP attends to individual patch tokens via a learned summary query, each token retains a strong standalone semantic alignment with text prompts. This eliminates the structural bottleneck that hinders standard CLIP backbones.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们表明,视觉语言结构的现代进步使得复杂的窗口管道变得没有必要,其最终目标是重振与语言一致、无培训的异常探测。
通过调查SigLIP家族采用并整合到C-RADIOv4[36]等现代基础模型中的多头注意力集合机制(MAP),我们发现一种新兴能力: MAP集成编码器直接从单个前传产生内在的紧密的视觉语言异常特征.
由于MAP通过学习的汇总查询来处理单个补丁符号,每个符号保留了与文本提示的强烈独立的语义对齐. 这消除了阻碍标准CLIP骨干的结构瓶颈.

blocks.en:
Leveraging these properties, we present a unified, training-free zero-shot anomaly detection framework, RADIOlogy.
For image-level detection, our pipeline scores global anomaly margins in a single forward pass, setting a new state of the art among training-free methods across benchmark datasets without crop ensembles.
For pixel-level segmentation, we exploit the complementary teacher heads natively exposed by C-RADIOv4. Its raw trunk features provide content-adaptive affinity graphs to sharpen defect boundaries, while SAM3-aligned features enable object-part clustering to preserve structural boundaries.
Together with a training-free foreground prior that suppresses background noise, our approach bridges the performance gap between multi-crop and single-pass training-free anomaly detection methods.
Finally, we observe that prior evaluations of training-free VLM methods in medical domains have been artificially constrained by inadequate industrial priors.
We show that, in the context of our specific pipeline, substituting domain-appropriate clinical terminology into the prompt ensemble yields state-of-the-art medical anomaly detection in the training-free zero-shot regime without per-dataset prompt engineering.
blocks.zh:
利用这些特性,我们呈现了一个统一的,无训练的零射异常探测框架,RADIOlogy.
就图像水平检测而言,我们的输油管在一次前传中评分全球异常幅度,在没有作物组合的基准数据集的无培训方法中设定了一种新的技术水平。
对于像素层面的分割,我们利用C-RADIOv4本地曝光的辅助师长. 其原始的树干特征提供了内容适应的亲和图以磨亮缺陷边界,而SAM3对齐的特征则使对象部分集群能够保存结构边界.
加上一个无训练的前缘,抑制背景噪音,我们的方法弥合了多作物和单路无训练异常探测方法之间的性能差距。
最后,我们注意到,以前对医疗领域无培训的VLM方法的评估受到工业前科不足的人为限制。
我们表明,在我们的具体管道中,将适合域的临床术语替换为在不使用每套数据即时工程的情况下,在无训练零射装置中迅速产生最新医学异常检测。

blocks.en: To summarize, our primary contributions are: • We introduce a contrastive anomaly scoring strategy that relies on the difference in alignment between normal and abnormal prompts, rather than on absolute similarity scores. • We formulate an anomaly segmentation refinement strategy that exploits the multi-teacher representations of C-RADIOv4 . • We identify MAP-based vision-language encoders as superior backbones for zero-shot anomaly detection in a single-pass regime. • We demonstrate that VLM ZSAD generalizes effectively to the medical domain in the training-free regime with minimal modifications.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Visual Anomaly Detection (AD) encompasses various operational regimes defined by the availability of target-domain data [ 3 , 37 ] .
Under standard unsupervised AD, models have access to a clean set of nominal training samples to construct a normality representation against which the out-of-distribution deviations are identified [ 11 , 50 ] .
Batched zero-shot settings evaluate small, unlabeled target sets containing mixtures of normal and anomalous images [ 28 ] .
In contrast, pure Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) operates under the strictest constraint: identifying and localizing anomalies in target datasets without access to any target-domain training samples whatsoever [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
视觉异常检测(AD)包括根据目标领域数据的可用性确定的各种操作制度[3,37]。
在标准无监督的反倾销协定下,模型可获得一套干净的名义培训样本,以构建一种正常性代表,从而确定分配外偏差[11,50]。
Batched 0-shot settings评价含有正常和异常图像混合物的小型无标签目标集 [28].
相比之下,纯零热异常检测(ZSAD)的运作受到最严格的制约:在目标数据集中识别异常并定位异常,而没有任何目标域培训样本[20].

blocks.en:
Within ZSAD, two primary methodologies have emerged: auxiliary-trained methods and training-free methods. Auxiliary-trained approaches rely on cross-dataset generalization by learning defect representations on unrelated base datasets.
These include prompt-tuning techniques that optimize continuous text/visual prompts [ 53 , 7 ] , full-network fine-tuning across multimodal components [ 30 , 54 ] , and synthetic defect injection schemes that simulate surface anomalies [ 13 ] .
While effective, auxiliary training incurs substantial adaptation costs and risks overfitting to synthetic or domain-specific defect archetypes.
blocks.zh:
在津巴布韦,出现了两种主要方法:辅助训练方法和无训练方法。 辅助训练的方法依靠交叉数据集的概括,在不相关的基础数据集上学习缺陷表现.
其中包括优化连续文本/视觉提示的快速调试技术[53,7],跨多式联运组件的全网络微调[30,54],模拟表面异常的合成缺陷注射方案[13].
辅助培训虽然有效,但会产生相当大的适应成本和风险,使之过于适合合成或特定领域缺陷型。

blocks.en:
Training-free methods, conversely, leverage the implicit world knowledge and semantic priors embedded within pretrained foundation models.
Foundational works, such as WinCLIP [ 20 ] and FADE [ 29 ] , query frozen CLIP representations against predefined compositional text prompts.
Recent extensions have explored generative reconstruction via diffusion inversion (e.g., DIVAD [ 19 ] ) or non-parametric patch memory retrieval (e.g., MRAD-TF [ 49 ] ).
However, generative and sliding-window architectures remain computationally prohibitive during inference, while raw CLIP features exhibit severe spatial degradation when evaluated densely.
Our framework advances the training-free ZSAD paradigm by eliminating windowed inference while achieving state-of-the-art segmentation quality among training-free methods.
blocks.zh:
反之,无训练方法则利用预先训练的基础模型中嵌入的隐含世界知识和语义学前科.
基础作品,如WinCLIP[20]和FADE[29],根据预定义的构成文本提示查询冻结的CLIP表达.
最近扩展通过扩散反转(如DIVAD [19])或非参数补丁内存检索(如MAD-TF [49])探索了基因重建.
然而,在推论期间,基因和滑动窗口结构在计算上仍然令人望而却步,而原始的CLIP特征在评价密度时显示出严重的空间退化。
我们的框架推进了无培训ZSAD模式,消除了视窗推论,同时实现了无培训方法中最先进的分化质量。

blocks.en:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) map visual and textual modalities into a shared metric embedding space via joint contrastive objectives [ 34 , 22 , 12 ] .
Standard CLIP backbones extract global image summaries using a dedicated [CLS] token [ 34 , 42 , 12 ] .
While effective for holistic scene understanding, the unconstrained self-attention in standard ViTs causes localized patch embeddings to degrade in semantic specificity, hindering fine-grained patch-text alignment [ 52 ] .
To address these representation bottlenecks, the SigLIP architecture [ 51 , 45 ] replaces the pairwise softmax contrastive loss with a pairwise sigmoid loss and adopts MAP.
MAP summarizes visual sequences via learned query probes, decoupling individual patch representations from global token mixing and, thereby, preserving localized semantic alignment [ 26 , 51 ] .
blocks.zh:
远景-语言模型(VLMs)通过联合对比目标将视觉和文字模式映射到共享的计量嵌入空间[34,22,12].
标准CLIP主干线使用专用的[CLS]符号提取全局图像摘要[34,42,12].
虽然对整体场景的理解有效,但标准上不受限制的自觉性 ViTs导致局部补丁嵌入在语义特异性中降解,阻碍精细的补丁文本对齐[52].
为了解决这些代表瓶颈,SigLIP架构[51,45]将双向软最大对比损失替换为双向西格莫德损失,并采用MAP.
MAP通过学习的查询探针对视觉序列进行总结,将单个补丁表达与全局符号混合脱钩,从而保持局部语义对齐[26,51].

blocks.en:
In parallel, foundation model distillation has yielded agglomerative multi-modal encoders that unify distinct capabilities into a single monolithic backbone [ 35 , 46 , 38 , 40 ] .
Exemplified by the RADIO framework [ 35 , 18 , 36 ] , these architectures employ lightweight projection adapters to simultaneously emulate diverse teacher spaces, including zero-shot segmentation (SAM [ 24 , 8 ] ), self-supervised dense geometry (DINOv2/v3 [ 32 , 41 ] ), and open-vocabulary language alignment (SigLIP2 [ 45 ] ).
By leveraging the unified feature space of C-RADIOv4, our work demonstrates that the synergy between MAP language alignment, the vision backbone’s structural affinities, and SAM part segmentation enables comprehensive, single-pass zero-shot anomaly localization without specialized network fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
同时,基础模型蒸馏产生了凝聚式多式联运编码器,将独特的能力统一为单一的骨干[35、46、38、40]。
以RADIO框架[35,18,36]为例,这些架构使用轻量级投影适配器同时模拟多样化的教师空间,包括零射片段(SAM [24,8]),自我监督的密密几何(DINOv2/v3 [32,41]),以及开放式伏波语言对齐(SigLIP2 [45]).
通过利用C-RADIOv4的统一功能空间,我们的工作表明,MAP语言对齐、视觉主干结构的亲和和SAM部分的分化之间的协同作用,能够实现全面、单程零镜头反常的本地化,而无需专门的网络微调。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of our proposed method. First, the input image is encoded by the agglomerative encoder and two of the three teacher heads (SigLIP2 and SAM3). Using the language-aligned features and the prompt ensemble a margin score is computed per token-embedding to obtain the image-level anomaly score and the raw patch-level margin scores (1). Then, pixel-level refinement is applied to the patch scores using context pooling (2), affinity refinement (3) and finally object-part pooling (4). The resulting scores are aggregated per patch and the final anomaly mask is obtained by applying the color-based foreground segmentation mask to the patch scores.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们拟议方法概览。 首先,输入图像由aglomeric编码器和三个师长中的两个(SigLIP2和SAM3)编码. 使用语言对齐的特性和即时综艺,每个符号组合计算比值分,以获得图像级异常分和原始补丁级比值分(1). 然后,将像素级的精细应用到补丁分数上,使用上下文集合(2),亲和度精细(3),最后将对象部分集合(4). 由此产生的分数通过每个补丁进行汇总,最后的异常面罩通过对补丁分数应用色基前缘分数面罩获得.

blocks.en:
We leverage the dense features of a MAP head-aligned vision encoder, obtained by a single pass through the model, to produce our anomaly detection mechanism. A MAP head summarizes a grid of tokens with a learned query that attends to each patch token produced by the vision backbone. The output of this head is a global representation of an image that is aligned with textual representations, using either a binary classification or a contrastive loss. In its simplest form, the pre-training task consists of classifying whether an input image and input text are related. Given that the token embeddings function as direct keys and values for the MAP head, and the head is relatively shallow compared to the vision backbone, it is forced to align the patch token representations aggressively to obtain a high-quality summary representation. This is structurally different from CLIP’s original recipe [ 34 ] ,
where the [CLS] summary token is mixed with every patch through
repeated self-attention blocks. The result is a more diluted relationship between the [CLS] token and each patch token, culminating in weak dense alignment. Note that although C-RADIOv4 does not use a MAP head internally, its alignment with the MAP module of SigLIP2 preserves its dense feature quality.

blocks.en: Given that image backgrounds are often featureless and lack distinctive semantics, applying a semantically-aligned patch-text margin to background patches results in anomaly score noise. To mitigate the effect of such distortion, we apply a foreground mask after applying the previously described patch scoring recipe. To this end, we propose a simple approach: a foreground prior computed exclusively from the image, with no backbone and no learned features.

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化结果

blocks.en: Table 1 contains the anomaly classification results for all methods and datasets included in this work (per-category results are in the supplementary material, Sec. S4 ). Our method significantly outperforms all other baselines on this specific task by a large margin in both industrial and medical datasets across all metrics except AP, where CLIP [ 34 ] in combination with our margin scoring rule slightly outperforms RADIOlogy in MPDD. The strength of the scoring rule in CLIP is further demonstrated in its average ranking, where it places second on all classification metrics. This highlights the benefit of following a contrastive approach to VLM-based anomaly detection irrespective of backbone: a language-aligned vision embedding containing an anomaly can only be scored properly with a normality baseline.

While RADIOlogy does not obtain the best results across all datasets, it achieves the best AUROC results in five out of seven industrial datasets and the best performance in all medical datasets. Moreover, it has the best average performance in both domains, outperforming all other methods in the industrial domain by at least 3.5 points and by between 5.7 and 10.7 points in the medical datasets.

blocks.en: Table 3 portrays the effect of the anomaly segmentation refinement steps we employ to increase the quality of raw patch margin scores. The table shows that all components have a positive effect on segmentation performance, as hypothesized. Additionally, we can observe that the context pooling alone raises performance above the training-free SOTA, with an improvement of more than 4 points over the raw scores. This highlights the importance of contextualization in language-based anomaly detection: as discovered by WinCLIP, a single visual patch often does not contain enough information to differentiate an anomaly from typical texture variation, but a large enough pool of adjacent tokens contains sufficient semantics to be classified correctly relative to surface noise. Results describing the adequacy of each teacher head for each step are available in the supplementary material, Sec. S2.1 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we showed that the computational complexity of windowed execution is not a fundamental prerequisite for prompt-based, zero-shot visual anomaly detection. By systematically analyzing the token-pooling dynamics of vision-language architectures, we demonstrated that multi-head attention pooling inherently preserves fine-grained, patch-level text alignment out of the box, overcoming the structural token-mixing limitations that have historically degraded standard [CLS] -based CLIP encoders. Exploiting this property alongside the distilled representations exposed by the agglomerative C-RADIOv4 backbone, our unified RADIOlogy framework computes global anomaly margins in a single forward pass while applying training-free pixel refinements to produce sharp, localized defect segmentations. Across fourteen industrial and clinical benchmarks, our approach sets a new state of the art in the training-free regime, delivering substantial gains over prior baselines while operating at a fraction of their inference latency.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们显示,窗口执行的计算复杂性并不是快速零镜头视觉异常检测的基本前提. 通过系统分析视觉语言架构的符号集合动态,我们证明了多头集注内在保存了精细的,补丁级的文本对齐出框,克服了历史上已经退化的标准[CLS]-基于CLIP编码器的结构符号混合限制. 利用这一特性,以及由巨型C-RADIOv4主干体所暴露的蒸馏表示,我们的统一的RADIOlogy框架在一次前传中计算出全球异常差值,同时应用无训练像素的改进来产生尖锐,局部的缺陷片段. 在整个14个工业和临床基准中,我们的做法为无培训制度设定了一个新的技术水平,比先前的基线取得了重大收益,而其运作却只占其推论的一小部分。

blocks.en: Our framework exhibits several limitations that present opportunities for future research. The heuristic foreground prior assumes nominal background borders, which fails for off-center objects that touch the image border. Incorporating depth estimation heads into agglomerative encoders could establish a robust geometric boundary to resolve this. Additionally, a performance gap persists between anomaly detection and localized segmentation. To tackle this, future directions include integrating multi-resolution token representations to capture fine structural defects and fine-tuning the C-RADIOv4 backbone to bridge the gap with trained ZSAD methods.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架显示出若干限制因素,为今后的研究提供了机会。 高压前景前置假设名义背景边框,这对触摸图像边框的离中心对象来说是失败的. 将深度估计头纳入星系编码器可以建立坚固的几何边界来解决这个问题。 此外,在异常探测和局部分割之间仍然存在性能差距。 为了解决这一问题,今后的方向包括整合多分辨率符号表示,以捕捉精细的结构缺陷,并微调C-RADIOv4主干线,以利用经过培训的ZSAD方法弥合差距。

blocks.en: S1 Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: S1 超参数 敏感性分析

blocks.en: S1.1 Context Pooling Window Size
blocks.zh: S1.1 上下文集合窗口大小

blocks.en: In Fig. S1 , we can observe the performance of RADIOlogy as we vary the size of the context pooling window from 3 to 12 on the MVTec-AD [ 3 ] dataset. All other hyper-parameters remain fixed. The results demonstrate robustness in both pixel AUROC and max-F1, the metrics reported in the main tables of this work. However, they do demonstrate sensitivity in the area under the per region overlap (AUPRO), larger windows have a negative effect compared to the reported hyper-parameters. This is to be expected, as excessively diffusing the margin scores results in less defined contours, an effect that is particularly detrimental for overlap-based metrics such as AUPRO.
blocks.zh: 在Fig.S1中,我们可以观测到RADIOlogy的性能,因为我们在MVTec-AD[3]数据集上将上下文集合窗口的大小从3到12不等. 所有其他超参数仍然固定。 结果显示,在这项工作的主要表格中报告的像素AUROC和最大-F1中,都具有稳健性。 然而,它们确实显示出每个区域重叠(AUPRO)下区域的敏感性,与所报告的超参数相比,较大的窗口具有负面影响。 这一点是预期的,因为过分分散比值的分数导致轮廓界定较少,这种影响对基于重叠的衡量标准,例如AUPRO,特别有害。

blocks.zh: S1.2 区域集合集集

blocks.en: Figure S2 showcases the effect of different k k -means cluster-set configurations under our method in the MVTec-AD dataset. As our approach supports clustering with multiple cluster numbers, we vary the sets with three quantities: 8, 32, and 128. The results demonstrate a high degree of stability within multiple cluster combinations, with multi-cluster sets generally performing slightly better than single cluster results. We hypothesize that this advantage is derived from multi-cluster setups covering more edge cases and object configurations within the dataset, where single cluster values can be either too coarse or too fine-grained for some MVTec categories ( e.g . the hazelnut category requires only a few clusters, while the complexity of objects such as cables or transistors benefits from additional cluster capacity).

blocks.en: S2 Extended Ablation Study
blocks.zh: S2 扩展读取研究

blocks.en: S2.1 Refinement Features Origin
blocks.zh: S2.1 完善地物起源

blocks.en: We perform an ablation study on the adequacy of the different features exposed by C-RADIOv4 in the segmentation refinement steps of Sec. 3.3 , depicted in Tab. S1 . The features analyzed include the C-RADIOv4 raw features and the embeddings obtained with the SAM3 [ 8 ] , DINOv3 [ 41 ] , and SigLIP2 [ 45 ] heads. The results support our hypothesis that the SAM substrate is the most suitable space for object-part clustering: it obtains the best AUPRO and max-F1 (+0.4 and +1.9 points over the RADIO trunk, the next best substrate), while matching the RADIO trunk on pixel AUROC. For affinity refinement, the differences between substrates are smaller (at most 0.6 AUPRO and 1.1 max-F1), with the RADIO trunk performing best on all three metrics. This could be caused by RADIO’s trunk features being of higher semantic quality compared to DINOv3, a reasonable result given its SigLIP2 supervision, which infuses it with a weakly supervised semantic signal that DINOv3 lacks. Finally, to demonstrate the need to combine different heads of RADIO, we include results for using the SigLIP2 head in the two steps individually and in both steps simultaneously. The SigLIP2 head is competitive for affinity refinement, but it is clearly worse than SAM for region pooling (2.2 points lower max-F1), and using it for both steps yields the lowest results in the table.

blocks.en: S2.2 Effect of the Foreground Mask
blocks.zh: S2.2 前景罩的影响

blocks.en: In order to demonstrate the benefits of foreground masking, we show the effect of removing the mask (No mask), employing the mask but removing its language gate (Mask, no gate), and the results for our declared configuration (Mask + language gate (declared)). We evaluate this effect on all the industrial datasets of our evaluation suite, as the benefit of the mask and gate is only apparent across domains. Table S2 contains the result of this ablation and demonstrates the positive effect of both our simple foreground mask and the declared language-gate. Both components improve the overall anomaly segmentation performance significantly and complementarily. Masking alone results in a ∼ \sim 1 point improvement in AUROC and max-F1, while combining both techniques improves pixel AUROC by 2.4 and 3.1 points in AUPRO over the unmasked pipeline.

blocks.en: S2.3 Effect of the Medical Vocabulary
blocks.zh: S2.3 医疗词汇的影响

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of our medical state vocabulary, we replace the medical descriptors in the reported pipeline with the same vocabulary employed in the industrial benchmarks. We perform the same replacement for SAA+ [ 6 ] and WinCLIP [ 20 ] to test whether the domain-adaptation vocabulary translates across techniques. The results can be observed in Tab. S3 and showcase a significant improvement over industrial descriptors for RADIOlogy. However, the effect is not conclusive for the other two techniques. While localization improves significantly in WinCLIP, detection is dramatically decreased by the medical prompts using the same method. Given that we did not observe this effect in our naive CLIP baseline, this hints at WinCLIP’s anomaly detection score being overfit to its own industrial vocabulary, a reasonable prior given its industrial scope. Additionally, the medical prompts improve SAA+’s AUROC but do not consistently improve its other metrics, and the effect is much smaller than for RADIOlogy. This is explained by SAA+’s relatively low reliance on the textual priors, which are mostly employed to condition its text-prompted region proposals rather than to compute the anomaly score directly.

blocks.en: S2.4 Aspect Ratio Correction
blocks.zh: S2.4 侧面比率校正

blocks.en: As mentioned in Sec. 4.1 , we observed that our pipeline is sensitive to extreme aspect-ratio deviations. The effect of this is most apparent in the KolektorSDD (KSDD) dataset, which contains many images formed by thin vertical strips with aspect ratios of more than 2.5:1. All other datasets have square-like resolutions hovering around the 1:1 ratio. Applying the tiling rule on KSDD results in a very significant performance gain in both detection and localization at the cost of two additional forward calls on smaller resolution images. We believe this aspect-ratio sensitivity is caused by two factors. First, KSDD’s aspect ratio is extremely out-of-distribution for C-RADIOv4, which is trained on square images. Second, the square resizing of the input dramatically changes the geometry of the defects, diffusing the anomaly among the normal pixels. This diffusion causes a large number of anomalous pixels to be mislabeled, an effect apparent in the recall between tiling and not tiling the input: 50.19% and 34.18%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 如第4.1节所述,我们注意到我们的管道对极端的偏差十分敏感。 在KolektorSDD(KSDD)数据集中,这一点的影响最为明显,其中包含许多由细纵条形成的图像,宽比超过2.5:1. 所有其他数据集都有方形分辨率,徘徊在1:1的比例左右. 应用KSDD的平板规则,在探测和本地化方面都会产生非常显著的性能收益,而代价是另外两次对较小的分辨率图像发出呼吁。 我们认为,这一方面-比率敏感性是由两个因素造成的。 首先,KSDD的侧面比例对于受过方形图像培训的C-RADIOv4来说是极不分布的. 第二,输入的正方形重新大小会大大改变缺陷的几何形状,在正常像素中扩散异常. 这种扩散导致大量反常像素被误贴标签,这种影响明显表现在输入的t与不t之间的召回:分别为50.19%和34.18%.

blocks.en: The results of ablating the input resolution of RADIOlogy on all industrial datasets can be observed in Tab. S6 and Tab. S7 . They illustrate that anomaly classification results increase almost monotonically with resolution. This may be due to anomalies having a larger absolute footprint in the image (in terms of the number of pixels), which is reflected in the summary MAP representation. However, anomaly segmentation performance peaks non-monotonically at a resolution of 448. While higher resolutions increase performance in datasets with the highest resolution details, such as VisA and MPDD, performance decreases significantly in texture-centric datasets such as DAGM and DTD-Synthetic. We hypothesize that this is caused by a particular optimal point between the fine-grained details provided by larger resolutions and the dilution of information caused within each patch, since they represent increasingly smaller regions of the input.
blocks.zh: 在Tab中可以观察到所有工业数据集的RADIOlogy输入分辨率的放大结果. S6和Tab. S7 (英语). 它们表明,异常分类结果几乎单调地随着分辨率的增加而增加。 这可能是由于图像上具有较大绝对足迹的异常现象(以像素数量来说),这一点在摘要的MAP表示中有所反映. 然而,异常分解性能以448的分辨率达到非杂质峰值. 虽然更高的分辨率提高了VisA和MPDD等分辨率最高的数据集的性能,但以纹理为中心的数据集如DAGM和DTD-Synthetic的性能却显著下降. 我们假设,造成这种情况的原因是,在较大决议提供的精细细节和每个补丁内造成信息稀释之间有特定的最佳点,因为它们代表了投入越来越小的区域。

blocks.en: S2.6 Effect of RADIO family and size
blocks.zh: S2.6 无线电通信组织家族和规模的影响

blocks.en: To analyze the effect of encoder size and RADIO versions on RADIOlogy, we ablate the size and variant of RADIO in Tab. S8 . The results demonstrate that, within the image level metrics, the newer C-RADIOv4 variants that distill newer state-of-the-art teachers [ 36 ] obtain the best results. Moreover, performance remains consistent among different backbone sizes in the RADIOv2.5 [ 18 ] family, with metrics scaling slightly with backbone size. However, within the C-RADIOv4 family, performance drops substantially in the pixel metrics of the so400m model, falling below the results of any of the previous RADIOv2.5 variants. We hypothesize that this drop is attributable to SigLIP2’s so400m architecture itself rather than model capacity: unlike the standard vision transformer variants underlying RADIOv2.5, so400m was obtained through a shape-optimized search targeting efficient global contrastive image-text alignment [ 1 ] , which favors a compact, well-pooled embedding over the preservation of fine-grained spatial detail.
blocks.zh: 为了分析编码器大小和RADIO版本对RADIOlogy的影响,我们降低Tab中的RADIO的大小和变体. blocks.en: S2.7 Performance of the RADIO Teachers
blocks.zh: S2.7 电台教师的表现

blocks.en: As our final ablation, we evaluate the effect of using the teachers of C-RADIOv4-h directly within the RADIOlogy pipeline. The goal of this ablation is to measure the quality of anomaly features lost due to RADIO’s distillation process. The results are visible within Tab. S9 and Tab. S10 , containing anomaly detections and segmentation results, respectively, in the complete evaluation suite. They demonstrate that the difference between using C-RADIOv4-h and its much larger teacher ensemble is marginal in the industrial datasets but significant in the medical domain. Our hypothesis is that the distillation mechanism of RADIO, which compresses multiple model spaces into a single unified manifold, causes a detrimental effect on out-of-distribution generalization ( e.g . medical images).

blocks.en: We illustrate failure cases of our RADIOlogy pipeline in Fig. S4 to demonstrate which elements should be targeted for improvement in future work. The first element is a failure of the masking strategy, which, in some situations, incorrectly masks the defect to be segmented; this failure mode is particularly common at object edges. A second failure mode is caused by the patch margin scores themselves, which can fail to detect anomalies entirely. The error in the VisA chewing gum category is likely caused by the lack of normal examples, which are required to understand the exact geometry of the object. The error in the last row (ColonDB) probably originates from poor vision-language alignment, which aligns superficial qualities such as light reflections and color variations with pathological properties. Replacing SigLIP with a medical vision-language encoder ( e.g . MedSigLIP [ 39 ] ) could improve this misalignment.
blocks.zh: 我们说明我们在图S4的放射线管道的故障案例,以表明哪些因素应该成为今后工作中改进的目标。 第一个要素是遮掩策略的失败,在某些情况下,它错误地掩盖了要分解的缺陷;这种失败模式在对象边缘特别常见. 第二个故障模式是由补丁比值本身得分造成的,它可能无法完全检测异常. VisA咀嚼口香糖类别中的错误很可能是由于缺乏正常的例子而导致的,这些例子需要理解物体的确切几何特征. 最后一行(ColonDB)的错误可能源于视觉语言的调和能力差,这种调和将光线反射和颜色变化等表面性能与病理属性相协调. 用医疗视觉语言编码器(如. MedSigLIP[39])可以改善这种错位.

blocks.en: Table S12 contains per-category results of RADIOlogy for all the datasets that include multiple categories. Since all the medical datasets contain a single category, the exhibited datasets consist only of industrial benchmarks. They demonstrate generally consistent results among a variety of categories and object types. However, there are outlier categories that disproportionately decrease the average metrics, notably at the image level. These include categories such as PCB1 and multiple categories of MPDD, which are generally characterized by having large object surface variation (PCB) or large geometric variations (MPDD). We believe such characteristics are difficult to summarize through the relatively simple prompt ensemble we employed and would generally require more targeted and detailed descriptions.

blocks.en: S6 Baseline Reproduction Details
blocks.zh: S6 基线复制细节

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison, every reproduced baseline is run from the authors’ own released code at its published zero-shot configuration and scored with its own evaluation code. Before trusting a method on benchmarks its paper does not report, we first validate it on the benchmarks it does. Extending a method to new benchmarks only requires adding a data loader and the category names used in the prompts; neither the model nor the scoring is modified. Below we list every deviation from the released code and the reason for it, so that the reported numbers can be traced back to the original implementations.
blocks.zh: 为确保进行公平的比较,每个转载的基线都从其公布的零镜头配置中从作者自己发布的代码中运行,并以自己的评价代码打分。 在相信其文件没有报告基准的方法之前,我们首先对其基准加以验证。 将方法扩展至新的基准只需要添加一个数据加载器和提示中使用的类别名称;模型和评分都没有修改. 下面我们列出所有偏离已发布代码的情况及其原因,这样所报告数字就可以追溯到最初的执行.

blocks.en: We use the public Accurate-WinCLIP-pytorch reimplementation [ 53 ] with its original encoder (OpenCLIP ViT-B/16+, LAION-400M, 240px), window sizes and prompt ensemble, without Gaussian smoothing of the anomaly maps, as in the original method. Run unmodified, it reproduces that repository’s published MVTec and VisA results exactly. For the remaining benchmarks, we only add a data loader and use the raw dataset folder names as class names, which reproduces the WinCLIP numbers cited by AdaCLIP on MVTec, VisA, BTAD, MPDD and DTD-Synthetic.
blocks.zh: 我们使用公用Accentate-WinCLIP-pytorch重制版[53],其原编码器(OpenCLIP ViT-B/16+,LAION-400M,240px),窗口大小和即时综艺,没有高斯平滑异常图,如原方法. 运行未修改, 它复制了存储器公布的 MVTec 和 VisA 结果 。 对于其余的基准,我们只添加一个数据加载器,并使用原始数据集名称作为类名,该类名称复制了AdaCLIP在MVTec,VisA,BTAD,MPDD和DTD-Synthetic上引用的WinCLIP数字.

blocks.en: We run the full SAA+ [ 6 ] model, unmodified, from the authors’ SAA-plus codebase: the class-specific language prompts, the object property prompts (area and location filters), the visual saliency rescoring, and the confidence prompting that merges the proposed masks into a continuous anomaly map. On MVTec-AD and VisA, we use the authors’ own prompt files unmodified. For the remaining benchmarks, which have no released configuration, we reuse the MVTec property-prompt defaults and SAA+’s general anomaly prompts, extended with a generic “defect” prompt and filled with each category’s name, the same class names used by every method, without tuning them per dataset. The medical benchmarks use the same prompts; replacing them with our medical vocabulary is evaluated in Sec. S2.3 . Following SAA+’s evaluation script, maps and masks are evaluated at 400 × 400 400{\times}400 , normal images enter the pixel-level metrics with all-zero masks, and the image score is the maximum of the anomaly map. On MVTec-AD and VisA, our run reaches 37.7 and 33.0 pixel max-F1, against the 39.4 and 27.1 reported by the authors. The released code does not reproduce the published numbers: an independent run of it reports 37.65 on MVTec-AD, which the authors attribute to differences between code versions. 1 1 1 https://github.com/caoyunkang/Segment-Any-Anomaly/issues/30

blocks.en: DIVAD [ 19 ] required four changes to its released code. 1. The Stable Diffusion 2.1 checkpoints used for DDIM inversion are no longer hosted by Stability AI. We load them from a community mirror whose weights we verified to be byte-identical (SHA-256) to the original release. 2. The released command passes --use_dino , which is declared as store_false and therefore disables the DINO segmenter, falling back to a ResNet-50. We keep DINO enabled, as intended by the method. 3. The list of MVTec texture categories exempted from the CutLER foreground mask contains zipper instead of grid . We correct it, so that masks are applied to object categories only, as described in the paper. With these first three changes, MVTec reads 75.9/88.1 image/pixel AUROC against the published 75.9/88.0. 4. On BTAD, the released evaluation retrieves each ground-truth mask from the first three characters of the four-digit image name prefixed with a zero, so test image 0049 is paired with the mask of image 0004 . Apart from the first image of each category, every defective image is therefore scored against the mask of another image. Because the image labels are also derived from these masks, the mismatch affects detection as well as localization. As shown in Tab. S15 , restoring the released lookup reproduces the published BTAD results exactly, which confirms that the lookup explains the discrepancy. Pairing each image with its own mask raises DIVAD’s results substantially, most notably the pixel AUROC, from 68.4 to 94.3. We report the corrected numbers in the main paper. Both BTAD runs follow the released protocol, without foreground masks.
